name: stale-signal-recompute
description: Detect when key observations have expired and trigger partial recomputation instead of reusing stale conclusions. Applied across all card types.
body:
# Stale Signal Recompute Guard

## Purpose
Prevent decision cards from being published when key evidence has exceeded its freshness window. Triggers partial recomputation rather than full task restart.

## Validation Steps
1. Scan all evidences for freshness_class == 'live' or 'recent'
2. Calculate age from observed_at or collected_at
3. If any evidence exceeds maximum_evidence_age_days, flag as stale
4. Apply confidence penalty proportional to staleness
5. Add failure condition recommending recomputation

## Stop Conditions
- More than 50% of evidences are stale
- Supply signals show 'alert' status with stale evidence
- No fresh evidence available for key claims
